title: tests: DID refresh, absent did and NoHost gaps
description:
DID-binding test gaps (batch 8b review, JMAP-0x0q.13/.48/.50). Code is correct today; these pin behaviour a refactor could silently break.

1. crate-jmap-did-resolver/tests/resolver.rs: refresh_fetches_one_did_at_most_once_per_60_seconds (L386) only covers a still-cached entry. Add a test that evicts the entry inside the 60 s window (with_max_entries(NonZeroUsize::MIN) plus a second DID, as full_cache_drops_its_oldest_entry L431 does) and asserts no second upstream fetch; also cover the bounded `refreshed` map's retain/drop-oldest eviction. Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00 refresh rule "SHOULD NOT resolve one DID again for this reason more often than once every 60 seconds".
2. crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs:1144 did_update_with_current_value_passes: covers stored `did: null` but not a stored object with no `did` key plus update `{"did": null}` -> None (the documented absent-counts-as-null rule, unwrap_or(&Value::Null)).
3. crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/tests/peer_deliver.rs: no negative test for IdentityBinding::NoHost with did_verified set. src/deliver.rs:258 rejects it correctly, but collapsing the match to `_ => peer.did_verified` would pass every test. Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 L256 "any other host-less identity MUST be rejected".
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
